current_hard_policy.general_approximate_hard_member_multipli: .5+.5*P/H where P=role pool size,H=observed top-quarter size; finite-batch rejections/fallback alter this
current_hard_policy.hard_draw: uniform with replacement; reject used-qid up to32 times then fallback uniform cycle
current_hard_policy.hard_pool: previous epoch observed qids ranked by mean four-view training BCE; top ceil(observed_qids/4)
current_hard_policy.reason: Only sampler-state hashes are in curve; complete sampler payload lives in large checkpoints and is not read

sampling_target_mismatch.current_sampling: positive q uniform over K1..9; negative q uniform over all; then uniform conditional ownG5 subset, four draws with replacement
sampling_target_mismatch.natural_class_balanced_target: q positive proportional pMix(q); q negative proportional1-pMix(q); then uniform class-conditional G5
